legenda: HB 3, 34th Alaska Legislature: sessions in Anchorage; repeals AS 44.06.050, .055 and .060.
texto_para_tela: HB 3 (2025): STILL IN ITS FIRST COMMITTEE
nota: VOLÁTIL: repetir na véspera de publicar. A 34ª Legislatura termina em janeiro de 2027. A cópia local do PDF já traz o cabeçalho 'SECOND SESSION BY REPRESENTATIVES G.NELSON, Rauscher…', coerente com a troca de autor de 13/02/2026.
narracao: In 2025, a House bill to hold legislative sessions in Anchorage proposed repealing the whole cost law, for the capital as well as the legislature. As of September 2026, the bill hadn't left its first committee.

conferencia.prova: "Introduced: 1/22/25 Referred: Community and Regional Affairs, State Affairs, Finance"; "Sec. 16. AS 44.06.050, 44.06.055, and 44.06.060 are repealed. Sec. 17. This Act takes effect January 1, 2027."
